artworks.title: Homer and Calliope
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown and gray wash and white andpink heightening, squared in graphite, on brown p aper
artworks.description: In the image, there are two central figures. One is an older man seated, shown from the chest up with one hand resting on a rolled scroll. He has a beard and disheveled hair, and his expression is focused as he gazes upward. The man's body is muscular and mostly uncovered, with a cloth draped over his lap. An elegant woman stands beside him, gesturing towards him, with styled hair and flowing garments. The background features architectural elements like columns and arches.

artworks.title: Masinissa and Sophonisba
artworks.medium: black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a classical style setting. On the left, a man with medium-length hair stands with his back to the viewer, slightly turned towards the center of the image; he is dressed in a loosely draped garment and holds an object in one hand. On the right side, a seated man with a crown points at the standing man. The seated man is wearing an intricate garment. In the background, another figure is partially visible behind drapery, observing the interaction. The background features classical architecture with columns and arches, along with foliage on the left side.

artworks.title: Prince Charming in the Forest
artworks.medium: pen and brush and red ink
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person with a bow and arrow in a dense forest setting. The drawing depicts a figure dressed in a tunic and cap, poised to release an arrow from a bow. The scene is set in a lush forest, with tall trees surrounding the figure. The trees have thick trunks with closely spaced vertical lines representing bark, and leafy branches arched overhead. The composition features flowing vines and flowers that frame the figure. Intricate detailing on the foliage and the figure's attire enhances the drawing's liveliness and organic feel.

artworks.title: Diana and Endymion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and red chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a slightly elevated view of a reclining male figure in the lower left, surrounded by scattered arrows. In the background, there are hills with vegetation. A figure is depicted above the man, encircled in a cloud formation. The painting uses fluid brushstrokes with sepia tones dominating the palette. A dog is seen to the right of the man, alongside lightly drawn trees and open space extending towards the hills.

artworks.title: Scene from the Inferno (canto IX)
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash
artworks.description: The image shows ethereal and earthly figures in a dynamic scene. Two winged, celestial beings interact with human figures in a turbulent sea. Additional figures are struggling, possibly within waves. One figure observes from the right. The illustration uses flowing lines and stark contrasts to convey movement and emotion, suggesting themes of struggle, observation, and the celestial versus mortal realms.

artworks.title: An Artist's Studio [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist in a studio surrounded by artworks. The image depicts a spacious studio with various pieces of art hanging on the walls and scattered on the floor. The wall is filled with drawings and paintings showing scenes and figures. An artist is seated at an easel, painting or drawing a canvas while holding a palette. The setting includes large windows bringing light into the space, and a nearby table holds sketches and rolled-up papers. A dog stands nearby.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape with Classical Temple
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with an elevated point of view. It shows details both close to the viewer and in the distance. The horizon is vaguely suggested by distant mountains and clouds. On the right, mountain peaks and a waterfall are visible. In the foreground, there is a classical structure with columns partially hidden by tall trees. The brushstrokes are bold and textured, indicating depth. The color scheme is primarily brown, giving an antique look. The background sky is sparse with wispy clouds.

artworks.title: View of Scheveningen [recto]
artworks.medium: gray wash over black chalk on buff paper//border in pen and black ink added by later hand
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a horizon featuring buildings, one of which has a high spire. In the foreground, there are rough pencil marks resembling loose terrain. The sketch is done in pencil with light brushstrokes, creating a monochromatic color palette. The background presents a simple sky, allowing the buildings and foreground to stand out.

artworks.title: Rustic House with a Well
artworks.medium: black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the composition, separating the sky and the land. The drawing features sketchy brushstrokes, creating a soft and unfinished appearance. The color scheme consists of pencil gray tones, establishing a gentle atmosphere. In the foreground, there are rustic structures, surrounded by trees with detailed foliage. A figure near a body of water is holding a fishing pole. The landscape extends into the distance, with faint hints of buildings on the horizon. Wispy clouds decorate the sky, contributing to the serene ambiance.

artworks.title: Five Saints
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures standing together. The central figure is holding a bow and arrows, dressed in armor with a detailed breastplate and a short skirt. The figure has short hair and a crested helmet with feathers. Around them are other individuals with distinct clothing, such as an elderly man with a beard and a hooded cloak holding beads, and another person holding a staff with a child on their shoulder. The group is accompanied by a lion at their feet and two flying cherubs overhead. The background is a simple, light-toned wash.

artworks.title: Religious Procession in Landeck
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink, graphite and watercolor
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a procession with various banners and figures. The image depicts a long horizontal arrangement of figures who are part of a procession or ceremonial gathering. Several banners are held high, with their fabric waving. The figures are loosely sketched, with minimal detail, yet distinct enough to convey their participation in a communal activity. The background remains lightly detailed, focusing the attention on the group of individuals and the banners they carry. The sparse use of color adds a subtle warmth to the otherwise monochromatic sketch.

artworks.title: Spanish Dancers
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening over graphite
artworks.description: The image features five women in traditional attire. Four women are seated closely together on the left side, while one woman stands on the far right holding a tambourine. They have distinct facial expressions and historic hair styling. They wear layered dresses and shawls in shades of brown and cream. The woman standing has a flowing dress. The sepia tones give the scene a classic look. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Seated Peasant Woman
artworks.medium: charcoal with white chalk and gray wash on gray paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated person shown from the side. The person is seated on a flat surface and is slightly turned to the right, facing away from the viewer. Their facial features are in profile, with the head tilted slightly forward. They have a scarf covering their hair, tied at the back. The person is dressed in a long garment with long sleeves, belted at the waist. The person is holding a basket against their knee, filled with what appears to be produce. The background is plain and neutral. The artist's signature, "Londone f," is visible in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Sleeping Peasant
artworks.medium: charcoal heightened with white on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person lying on their side, reclining on a large sack or pillow. One arm rests on the sack, while the other is placed on their side. The person's head is turned to the left, with eyes closed. They have short hair and are dressed in loose, flowing clothing. Nearby on the ground is a wide-brimmed hat. The background is simple and sketch-like.

artworks.title: Young Girl with a Red Bandana
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated, facing forward. She has a relaxed expression with soft features, dark hair, a red headscarf with white patterns, a blouse with wide sleeves, a corset-like garment, and a subtle necklace. The background has earthy tones, greens, light, and shadow creating a textured effect.

artworks.title: Lazarille de Tormes Stealing Drink from a Blind Man
artworks.medium: graphite and white body color on boxwood
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals interacting at a small table. One person is seated, while the other is partially kneeling or crouching, leaning on the table with one arm extended towards the other. The seated individual is shown from the side, dressed in loose clothing with a cape draped over their shoulders and wearing a hat. Their facial features include a beard, and they appear focused on something at the table. The other person has short, tousled hair and is also seen in profile, with a concentrated expression. They are dressed in simple, loose-fitting garments, and their posture suggests engagement in the activity. On the table, there is a jug and some small items. The background features a lightly sketched interior with a draped fabric hanging behind them.

artworks.title: Studies for the Raising of the Daughter of Jairus
artworks.medium: graphite with white wash on gray paper
artworks.description: The image shows three studies of a male figure. One study depicts the figure standing with arms raised, wearing draped robes. Another study shows him reclining with his eyes closed, and the third study shows him reclining with his head turned upward. The attire consists mainly of draped fabric, detailed with shading for texture and volume. There are no visible accessories or objects, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Christ before Caiaphas
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with blue wash, indented with stylus
artworks.description: The image shows a group of male figures gathered in a classical setting. One figure has his back turned toward the viewer facing a seated elderly man with a long beard. The central character is shirtless, wearing only a loincloth and carrying a staff. Another central figure with long hair stands next to him. Other figures surround them, some dressed in robes and others in Roman-style helmets holding spears. Various expressions are visible on their faces. The scene is in shades of blue with an architectural column and draped fabric in the background, suggesting an indoor setting. A building-like structure is visible outside through an opening. A small dog is lying near the seated figure. The sketch-like image shows detailed lines and shading that give depth to the characters and surroundings.

artworks.title: Saint Homobono
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of numerous figures gathered together. The central figure is handing something to another figure using a crutch. There are additional figures surrounding them, some partially visible. One figure is cloaked and appeared to be seated or kneeling. The drawing is done in a monochrome palette with shading for depth. The use of dark outlines and light washes gives the image an old-world feel. The composition is balanced with flowing lines indicating movement and interaction.

artworks.title: Two Studies of an Elderly Man's Head
artworks.artist: Paulus Pontius after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper, verso blackened for transfer
artworks.description: The image is a drawing showing two head-and-shoulders portraits of an older man. Both portraits are viewed from the side with one head positioned above the other. The man's head is turned slightly downward, and he has a long, flowing beard and hair falling over the back of his neck. His facial features are prominent and well-defined, with a pronounced nose and furrowed brow. The man does not wear clothing, and his shoulders appear bare. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is a simple textured surface.

artworks.title: Cupid
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in a dynamic composition. The main figure is in profile, with one foot on the ground and the other slightly lifted. The figure has curly hair and a muscular build, drawing a bow with an arrow. The second figure, positioned lower and in front, has flowing, curly hair and wings, holding their right hand upwards. The background is simple, with faint script visible on the right side. The drawing is in sepia tones.

artworks.title: Study of a Back
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's upper body, with a detailed drawing from the shoulders up. The person's facial features are faintly sketched, with limited detail on the face and no visible hair. The focus is on the anatomy of the upper body, with visible muscular lines. The background is the textured surface of the paper, with visible grain and marks typical of an aged sketch. The paper shows signs of wear and some stains, contributing to the vintage appearance of the artwork.

artworks.title: The Founding of Santa Maria Maggiore
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and white heightening over black chalk
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around an object. The drawing features several individuals wearing hats and flowing garments. The figures appear to be focused on a central action or object that involves a long, staff-like item being handled. The background includes a simple architectural structure. The lines and use of shading add depth and texture to the composition, and the monochromatic palette suggests it may be a preparatory sketch or study for a more detailed work in another medium.

artworks.title: Allegory of Fortitude
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray and brown wash, heightend with white gouache, over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting with her body slightly turned to the side and her head facing downward. She has long, wavy hair, a helmet on her head, and is wearing a draped garment. Her right arm rests on a plinth with a cylindrical object, and her left hand holds a leafy branch. Next to her lies a lion. The background is a solid color.
